name: carriage
title: Stand carriage: the leg's mount on two rods
orientation: The hip's face on the bed, the bosses up; each bearing pocket is a teardrop across the layers
description: A plate on two LM8UU bushings. The hip housing screws to its face and the hip's motor goes through its middle. It rides up the rods as the foot pushes, so the scale reads the leg.

plate.rule: The plate's thickness: three M3 screws bite here and carry the leg into the bushings

hub.rule: The plate's round middle: past the feet, for the screws

arm_w.rule: The arms' width, out to the bosses

half_w.rule: To the far side of a boss

boss_long.rule: A boss along the rod: 24 mm of bushing and a 2 mm wall with the rod's hole at the far end

boss_h.rule: Up from the face, past the bushing

rod_y.rule: The rods' distance behind the face

cut.rule: The motor's way through: a NEMA 17 and 1.1 mm each side

corner.rule: Round the corners of the motor's window

pilot.rule: M3 self-tapped into the plate, from the housing
